description: React component for managing team members dropdown menu in Mattermost, including role changes, removal, and demotion modals.

classes.name: TeamMembersDropdown
classes.description: React component for displaying and managing a dropdown menu for team members, allowing role changes, removal, and self-demotion.

methods.name: handleMakeMember
methods.description: Promotes a user to member or demotes self if system admin.

methods.name: handleRemoveFromTeam
methods.description: Removes a user from the team.

methods.name: handleMakeAdmin
methods.description: Promotes a user to admin or demotes self if system admin.

methods.name: handleDemote
methods.description: Prepares state for demoting a user.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the dropdown menu with role options, removal, and demotion modal.
